'''Jarmat's Island Hideaway''' was a tropical island on an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Rented by [[Jarmat Dav're]] from the [[Outer Rim Travel Services]], the island consisted for a basic landing zone, two huts, and a portable [[Refresher/Legends|refresher]]. Dav're used the island as a hiding spot, laying low from the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] after becoming aware of and investigating anti-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] rumors while working for [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]].<ref name="HS" />
